messages:
alex: Heads-up — scheduled maintenance for inference routing KV-cache compaction in eu-central1.
Time: Tue 2026-04-07 02:00–02:20 UTC (20m window). Expected impact: brief reconnects for long-lived streaming connections (clients should automatically retry), new /generate requests should be routed normally. No model version changes.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: https://internal.ops/redwood/maintenance/3498765432 :calendar: (runbook pinned in #eng-oncall)

maria: I'll take bridge/primary oncall for this window. Planning to join 01:45 UTC to pre-check.

jamal: Please confirm scope. Is this control-plane-only or will serving nodes be drained?

alex: Scope = control-plane routing layer + KV cache compaction on a subset of edge routers in eu-central1. Serving nodes not drained. We will roll the routers in small batches to keep <5% of traffic hitting a fallback path.

alex: Runbook (short):
```text
- 01:30 UTC: verify health of eu-central routers (kpi: routing-errors <0.1%)
- 01:45 UTC: open bridge, stakeholder check-in
- 02:00 UTC: start compaction on router group A (target 3m)
- 02:05 UTC: observe metrics, move to group B
- 02:12 UTC: finish remaining groups if healthy
- 02:20 UTC: validation, close bridge
- If errors >0.5% for >3m: abort and rollback routing configs
```

dena: Draft status page blurb (please edit):
"Planned maintenance: brief routing compaction in eu-central1 on Tue 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. Users may experience short reconnects for streaming sessions. No degradation to request throughput expected. Maintenance window: 20 minutes."

dena: Draft customer email (short):
"Hi — We will perform a brief planned maintenance in eu-central1 on Tue Apr 7 02:00–02:20 UTC to improve routing stability. Some streaming sessions may reconnect briefly; normal requests should continue. If you have dedicated/private deployments, there is no impact. — Redwood Inference Ops"

sneha: Quick question — will Dedicated customers see any effect? We should call that out clearly in the email.

alex: Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) customers: no impact. Only hosted routing layer in eu-central1. I'll update the email copy to be explicit.

jamal: Rollback plan: if we see elevated 5xx or routing-errors after a batch, revert router config with the pinned snapshot and post an incident if >5% customer error. Also enable fallback to compatible model-variant for 10m.

maria: joining bridge early to validate tracing and stream reconnect behavior with our test harness.

statusbot: Maintenance event published to Status Page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3498765432-planned-routing-compaction :loudspeaker:

--- (later updates during window) ---

maria: 02:08 UTC — compaction finished early for groups A/B. Observed 10s reconnects in internal stream tests, no production errors above baseline. Continuing validation.

ops-bot: Observability snapshot: routing-errors spike to 0.18% at 02:03 for ~40s, back to baseline by 02:05. No 5xx or customer-facing degradations.

maria: 02:12 UTC — closing bridge. All checks green.

ops-bot: Maintenance completed at 02:12 UTC. Status page updated to "Completed — no customer impact observed." https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3498765432

dena: Sending customer notification now (to hosted customers in EU and internal CCs). Template updated to explicitly mention Dedicated/Private unaffected.

sneha: Thanks — support will triage any tickets but nothing flagged so far.

alex: Postmortem slot: quick RCA doc will be created and circulated by EOD. Thanks everyone for quick ops and oncall coverage. :thumbsup:
